articles.title: Inside Brad Gerstner’s Portfolio: Every Move He Made in the Third Quarter
articles.description: Key TakeawaysBrad Gerstner’s Altimeter Capital opened a $680 million Tesla position in the third quarter, added to Meta Platforms and Micron, and sold out of Qualcomm and Applied Materials. Tesla trades at about 180x forward earnings, and analysts’ average target is just 7% above the price, so the new stake is a bet on Robotaxi profits that the estimates don’t show yet.
